summary.text: Karen Ortiz is an attorney and former U.S. Equal Employment Opportunity Commission administrative judge running on her own "Karen Ortiz" party line in New York's 12th Congressional District. According to her campaign website, she was dismissed from federal employment in 2025 after speaking out against executive orders. She is campaigning on accountability for the Trump administration, Medicare for All and ending U.S. military aid to Israel.

paragraphs.text: Describes herself as born in New York's 12th District and raised primarily in Garden City, Long Island; Ballotpedia lists Garden City High School as her high school.

Earned a bachelor's degree from Columbia University (1994) and a law degree from Fordham Law School (1998), according to Ballotpedia; she also holds a 2011 certificate from the Laughing Lotus Yoga Center and is a certified yoga instructor.

According to her campaign website, began her legal career as an undergraduate assisting criminal defense attorney Barry Slotnick, then worked in public service for the U.S. Equal Employment Opportunity Commission (as an administrative judge), the NYC Department of Parks & Recreation, the Social Security Administration, the NYC Taxi & Limousine Commission and MTA NYC Transit.

Says she was among the first federal workers to speak out against the Trump administration's executive orders in early 2025 and was terminated after refusing to follow its executive orders on transgender people.
Says she took part in the Global Sumud Flotilla as a U.S. delegate.
